sentences.en: [Scene 1: Monday morning at the office]
[Cathy] Morning, Alice. I'm just following up on the email I sent last week.
sentences.ko: 지난주에 보낸 이메일에 대해 확인차 연락드립니다.

sentences.en: [Alice] Oh, sorry — it slipped past me. Could you cc me on that email?
sentences.ko: 그 이메일에 저를 참조로 넣어 주실 수 있나요?

sentences.en: [Cathy] Sure. I'll loop you in once I hear back.
[Alice] Thanks for always having my back at work.
sentences.ko: 회사에서 늘 내 편 들어줘서 고마워.

sentences.en: [Cathy] Of course. Hey, could you weigh in on my decision?
sentences.ko: 제 결정에 대해 의견 좀 주실 수 있나요?

sentences.en: [Alice] Sure, what's going on?
[Cathy] I'm torn between these two options.
sentences.ko: 저는 이 두 선택지 사이에서 갈등하고 있어요.

sentences.en: [Alice] That's a tough one. Let's table this discussion until next week.
[Cathy] Good call. Could you send out the minutes after the meeting?
sentences.ko: 회의 끝나고 회의록 좀 돌려주실 수 있어요?

sentences.en: [Alice] Will do. And go ahead home early — I'll wrap things up here.
sentences.ko: 그럴게요. 그리고 먼저 들어가세요 — 여긴 제가 마무리할게요.

sentences.en: [Cathy] Really? I really owe you big time for this favor.
sentences.ko: 이번 부탁 정말 크게 신세 졌어.

sentences.en: [Alice] Don't worry. You can count on me whenever you need help.
sentences.ko: 도움이 필요할 땐 언제든 나만 믿어.

sentences.en: [Scene 2: On the way home — subway & post office]
[Alice] Excuse me, does this train go to Gangnam Station?
[Passenger] It does, but you'll have to change trains.
[Alice] Right, I have to transfer to the green line.
[Alice] Could you let me know when to get off?
sentences.ko: 언제 내려야 할지 알려주실 수 있나요?

sentences.en: [Passenger] Sure, I'll give you a heads-up.
[Alice] Hi, I'd like to send this package overseas.
[Clerk] No problem. Anything fragile inside?
[Alice] No. How long does shipping usually take?
[Clerk] About a week to most countries.
[Alice] It's finally warming up outside these days.
[Alice] I love the cool breeze on summer evenings.
sentences.ko: 여름 저녁의 시원한 바람이 정말 좋아.

sentences.en: [Scene 3: Home — dinner & packing]
[Alice] I'm home! I'll whip up a quick stir-fry for dinner.
[Bob] Sounds perfect. What can I do?
[Alice] Could you set the table while I cook?
sentences.ko: 제가 요리하는 동안 식탁 좀 차려주실래요?

sentences.en: [Bob] On it. Oh — I'm running out to grab some groceries.
[Alice] Okay, and could you take out the trash on your way out?
[Bob] Sure thing.
[Alice] I need to do the dishes before bed.
[Bob] I'll dry. So, all set for your trip?
sentences.ko: 내가 물기 닦을게. 그래서, 여행 준비는 다 됐어?

sentences.en: [Alice] Almost. My flight got bumped to tomorrow morning.
[Bob] Already? Are you flying straight there?
[Alice] No, I'm just passing through on my way to Tokyo.
sentences.ko: 저는 도쿄로 가는 길에 잠깐 경유하는 거예요.

sentences.en: [Bob] Got it. Travel light, then.
[Alice] I will. At the gate I'll just ask, 'Could you put my bag in the overhead bin?'
sentences.ko: 제 가방을 머리 위 짐칸에 넣어주실 수 있을까요?

sentences.en: [Bob] Ha, good plan. Safe travels.
